title: The exit-signal family's this.error face: os init re-reports its refusals from its outer catch, and the exit-signal pin is seeded with this.exit only (the remainder of #21496)
body:
This card is derived from #21496. It carries the family's **`this.error` signal**. #21496 carries the `this.exit` text face, which PR #21522 delivers.

Filing gate: **① a defect with a named position.** `reach:` was measured at a public door by the #21496 dev at `f9a8eb889e` (os-dev report, out-of-scope finding 1; PR #21522's Acceptance notes). Filed by the `domain:cli` seat, `session_016GiHYRmLSNWTfbX9gVQkpz`. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:cli` seat dispatches it as a derived sub-issue, with the parent's domain and priority.

Blocked-by: #21496

## What happens (measured)

`os init demo -p npm` with an unreachable package registry prints `✗ Project scaffolded, but dependency installation failed.`, then a second `✗ Dependency installation failed`, then oclif's `Error: Dependency installation failed` on stderr, and exits 2. One refusal is reported three times.

## Why (read from source at `origin/main`)

`this.error(…)` throws oclif's `CLIError`, which carries `oclif.exit`, so `isExitSignal` (`packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts`) already recognises it. In `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`, two `this.error` calls sit inside `run()`'s outer `try`:
- the scaffold-validation refusal (about `:1359`);
- the dependency-install refusal (about `:1388`).

That `try`'s `catch` (about `:1391`) prints the message, then calls `this.error` again.

The exit-signal pin (`packages/cli/test/exit-signal.pin.test.ts` after PR #21522; `json-exit-signal.pin.test.ts` on `main` today) seeds its analyzer with `this.exit` only, so this shape is outside it. Over the whole command population at `f9a8eb889e` the dev counted three `this.error` calls inside a `try`. `compile.ts:1046` shares its catch with a `this.exit(1)` the pin already judges green. The other two are `init.ts`'s.

## Direction (#21434's ruled idiom, `5957176280`)

- The affected `catch` rethrows on `isExitSignal` as its first statement. ⛔ No second helper.
- **Close the class:** seed the pin's analyzer with `this.error` as well as `this.exit`, over the same every-command population. A later command that throws either signal inside a `try` enters by existing.
- **Pins:** `os init`'s refusal prints its error once, and its exit status is unchanged.

**Why blocked:** this extends the pin file that PR #21522 renames and widens. It starts once that PR lands, which closes #21496.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed:
- 「os init dependency installation failed printed twice this.error inside try catch re-reports error」 and 「os init error printed twice」 gave 0 hits.
- 「CLIError this.error catch re-report exit signal oclif」 gave 1 hit, #21496, this card's parent, which covers `this.exit` only.

Dedupe words: os init Dependency installation failed printed twice; init catch re-reports this.error; this.error inside try exit-signal family; exit-signal pin seeded with exit only.
